description: This file defines a React component related to signing out other sessions of a user. It includes UI elements such as dialogs and buttons to confirm ending all other sessions, utilizing React hooks and external libraries like '@reach/alert-dialog' and 'mobx-react-lite'. The component manages interaction with application and view controller objects to perform session revocation.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Closes the dialog by setting the 'otherSessionsSignOut' state to false.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Revokes all other sessions for the application, shows an alert, and closes the dialog.
